content: Regular laboratory and medical tests, such as complete blood counts and kidney function tests, should be conducted while you are taking this medication to monitor your health. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to adhere to the prescribed schedule. Contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to receive instructions on how to adjust your dosing schedule. For proper storage of this medication, refer to the product instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. The information provided here was last updated in August 2024.
